newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares slip but hold up comparably well.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares slip but hold up comparably well.

text.p: Norwegian shares clawed back early losses to close marginally down on Friday after a steep selling wave on Wall Street a day earlier.

Dealers said the market appeared remarkably resistant following the U.S. plunge and the corresponding correction in other European markets. But near-term direction remained difficult to predict, they said.

Oslo's Total share index took a sharp downward move in early trade to an intraday low at 1,048.74 points. The market steadily recovered throughout the afternoon to end 0.23 percent off from Thursday's record close at 1,055.11 points.
Turnover was 20 percent up on a day ago at 1.21 billion crowns.
Data processing company Minard rose strongly in good volume due to market rumors of a possible takeover, dealers said.
The share advanced 16 percent to 14.50 crowns in 2.27 million crowns of trade.
